rule: Frozen selection rule:  * Pool of a method: its test-split systems with the complete 5 x 5 design whose public RNP input has exactly one protein sequence and one SMILES, with at most 768 Chai tokens after padding (residues plus ligand heavy atoms); the E24 rule applied to the method's table. * Confidence of a system: mean over the five archived seeds of the seed-level top ranking score of the method; own tiers are the tertiles of that confidence within the pool. * Protenix: the 90 systems of E24 (configs/seedext_v1_systems.json), all of which are in the Protenix pool; the design tier is the E24 (Chai-1) tier so that the primary analysis has the same weighting as E24. The own tier is kept for the secondary analysis. * Boltz-2: its whole pool (the systems released after its training cutoff leave 93 systems in 49 clusters); the design tier is the own tier. Only 31 of the 90 E24 systems are in the Boltz-2 table, so a one-per-cluster 40/30/20 draw is not possible. * Seeds: the five archived RNP seeds of the method (ascending) followed by 15 new seeds, int(sha256(f"cofoldpilot-seedext-v2-{method}-seed:{system_id}:{j}").hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 2**31 for j = 1, 2, ..., skipping values already used for the system. * Boltz-1 (method key "boltz" as in the RNP tables): the E24 systems that are complete in the Boltz-1 table (88 of 90), design tier =

boltz.design: the 88 E24 systems complete for the method (missing: 7slz__1__1.A__1.B, 8qtj__1__1.A__1.E); design tier = E24 (Chai-1) tier
